text:
Tess (PM): quick design sync 1: testers called out inconsistent language between the console help panel and docs. console header says 'Docs panel' and docs use 'In-product help'. Can we standardize?
Rico (Design): yeah that's noisy. I prefer 'In-product help' as the canonical phrase. it's clearer to end users.
Jun (Docs): we already use 'In-product help' in the glossary. If console switches we'll need to update a handful of screenshots and the in-app link text.
Maya (DevEx): low-risk change. note: update i18n key `help_panel_title` to avoid breaking translations. Also check deep links - current sidecar opens absolute /help which routes to external site. we should deep-link to `/docs/in-product-help#overview`.
a11y-bot: remember to keep visible heading concise and expose full phrase in aria-label if we shorten visually.
Rico (Design): idea: keep visible short title 'Help' in the panel header and render the full phrase inside the panel body: 'In-product help (aka Docs panel)'. this keeps the header compact and aligns with docs. thoughts?
Jun (Docs): that works as long as the body contains the canonical term and a link to the glossary anchor `/docs/glossary#in-product-help`. I'll add a short explainer sentence: "In-product help: contextual docs and links accessible from the console."
Maya (DevEx): implementation notes: use `data-internal-link` for SPA nav so hash anchors work. ensure target=_self for internal docs. We'll also add `aria-label="In-product help"` to the header element so screen readers hear the full phrase even if visual label is 'Help'.
Tess (PM): decision: visual header = 'Help', panel body includes 'In-product help' as canonical term + glossary crosslink. i18n key updated, SPA deep-linking for `/docs/in-product-help#overview`, and add aria-label on header. owners: Jun (docs) update copy & anchor, Rico update mock, Maya implement link handling and aria.
Jun (Docs): I'll open a PR updating the glossary anchor and the short panel explainer. PR note: sync with UI change so reviewers catch it. ETA 36h.
Rico (Design): I'll update the mock and push to the design system repo. small mobile note: when header is compact, put the canonical term in the first paragraph to avoid truncation issues.
Maya (DevEx): I'll add a small compatibility shim for old `/help` links and wire `data-internal-link` handler. ETA next sprint.
a11y-bot: checklist: aria-label on header, role=region for panel body, aria-live polite for dynamic content, and focus management when opening links.
Tess (PM): thanks team 1: we'll validate on staging once PRs land. closing thread after staging signoff. :white_check_mark:
